items.event_title: China's CXMT says fifth-generation DRAM platform has entered mass production
items.news_summary: CXMT said its new fifth-generation DRAM platform entered mass production and introduced 24Gb LPDDR5X products, advancing China's domestic memory capability.
items.investor_materiality: Direct competitive and supply implications for Micron, Samsung and SK Hynix, with potential effects on DRAM pricing and China's semiconductor self-sufficiency.
items.selection_reason: Fresh, concrete semiconductor production milestone verified by Reuters and unusually relevant to U.S. memory investors.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters report based on CXMT announcement; high-quality verification of the production milestone.

items.event_title: AI leaders face antitrust lawsuit over alleged agreement to slow AI development
items.news_summary: A U.S. lawsuit alleges Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Google coordinated an agreement to slow AI development, raising a novel antitrust issue around AI-safety coordination.
items.investor_materiality: Could affect Google and the competitive/regulatory framework for frontier AI labs and AI-capex expectations; allegations remain unproven.
items.selection_reason: Fresh legal catalyst with a strong AI-regulation and mega-cap technology angle, reported by AP and multiple outlets.
items.source_quality_note: AP is the primary high-quality reporting cited by the discovery feed; lawsuit allegations must be framed as allegations.

items.video_angle: AI 公司为了安全一起踩刹车，竟然也可能触发反垄断？这对 Google 和 AI 军备竞赛意味着什么

items.event_title: 10-year Treasury yield hovers around 5% after Fed hike
items.news_summary: The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield remained around the psychologically important 5% level after the Fed's first hike since 2023, keeping valuation pressure on equities.
items.investor_materiality: The 10-year yield is a core discount-rate input for growth stocks and a key financing benchmark; sustained 5% yields matter broadly for U.S. equities.
items.selection_reason: Fresh market-level development with immediate valuation implications and a clean Chinese investing-channel hook.
items.source_quality_note: WSJ fresh market reporting plus Reuters context; verify live yield before publication.
items.youtube_query: 10 year Treasury yield 5 percent Nasdaq stocks

items.event_title: Prologis says leasing is surging as data-center demand supports outlook
items.news_summary: Prologis CFO Tim Arndt highlighted improving leasing activity and data-center-related demand as growth supports.
items.investor_materiality: Links AI/data-center buildout to logistics real estate and provides a second-order AI infrastructure beneficiary beyond chips and power.
items.selection_reason: Fresh company commentary with a differentiated AI-infrastructure angle for a large U.S.-listed REIT.
items.source_quality_note: Fresh Yahoo Finance report; management commentary should be distinguished from previously reported quarterly results.

items.event_title: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs post fresh net inflows as Bitcoin holds above $80,000
items.news_summary: Fresh flow reports showed renewed net inflows into U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs while Bitcoin traded above $80,000, pointing to revived institutional demand.
items.investor_materiality: ETF flows can affect Bitcoin liquidity and crypto-linked U.S. equities including Coinbase, Strategy and miners.
items.selection_reason: Identifiable fresh flow catalyst rather than generic price commentary; useful cross-asset signal for U.S. investors.
items.source_quality_note: Multiple fresh market sources; exact daily total varied across snapshots and should be verified before quoting a number.

items.event_title: Trump says he will create an 'AI Force' amid debate over slowing frontier AI development
items.news_summary: President Trump said he plans an 'AI Force' with a possible law-enforcement role as concerns over frontier-AI development intensify.
items.investor_materiality: Signals potential new federal AI-policy and enforcement architecture affecting frontier labs, cloud providers and semiconductor demand expectations.
items.selection_reason: Fresh U.S. policy signal directly connected to the current AI-safety slowdown debate.
items.source_quality_note: Fresh Fortune reporting on presidential remarks; implementation details remain uncertain.
